body:
Seems like people have hard time at making friends, well I have a hard time at keeping them. Returned to home town after a long time only to find out that a couple of friend that made seems the city home, have found abode in other cities. Its the festival season which has made me realize that I might not have given friendship the importance it deserved. Its not like that I did not make friends, I made and I made a lot, but friendship requires maintenance. I have felt this for long and here I pour my heart out, well now I have decided to make peace with and look forward to more, if it happens, it will happen for good and if it doesn't well we tried, didn't we?
Someone said : "May you never look so desperate to be friends with your own friends".
